outputs.explanation: Panel A contains only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, merge); there is no plot of averaged data.
Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red, and anti-HMGB1 intensity) shown as mean with error bars (n=20) but no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a Western blot image only; no averaged quantification plot is shown.
Panel D shows bar charts of signal intensity (SDH and COX staining quantification) with error bars and sample sizes indicated, but individual data points are not plotted.

Panel E shows FACS histogram distributions (cell count vs TMRM intensity) for individual replicate experiments; these are raw distribution plots, not averaged summary bar/box plots, so overlaying individual points is not applicable.
